title: When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.25402v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. translated_title: 当形式改变而逻辑不变：通过逻辑结构构建逻辑不变的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在多种推理任务上取得了优异的表现，但这种表现究竟反映了对底层逻辑结构的理解，还是对浅层语义线索的依赖，目前仍不清楚。衡量这种理解的一个关键指标是：模型能否对逻辑等价的输入保持一致的预测——即尽管表达方式不同，预测结果依然相同。通过在精心构建的数据上进行系统评估，我们发现即使是强大的LLM也常常无法通过这一测试：它们无法在逻辑等价的输入之间稳定地保持预测结果，并且对未见过的逻辑形式泛化能力较差。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了LoGIST（逻辑结构引导推理），一个用显式逻辑结构来引导LLM推理的框架。LoGIST将每个输入实例映射为一个决策图——一种刻画底层逻辑结构的有向无环图——并将该图编码为……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出LoGIST框架，通过将输入映射为显式的逻辑决策图（有向无环图）来引导大语言模型推理，使其在逻辑等价的输入上保持一致的预测，从而构建真正理解逻辑结构、对表面形式变化保持不变的LLM。
en_tdlr: Proposes LoGIST, a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure by mapping each input to a decision diagram (a directed acyclic graph), enabling models to produce consistent predictions across logically equivalent inputs and achieve logic-invariant reasoning.
